FOUR INDEPENDENT PROOFS THAT THE CATALOGUE IS EMPTY, not merely blocked: (1) The shop landing page https://food52.com/pages/shop renders an explicit shutdown notice, verbatim H2 'Thanks for visiting the Shop' + H3 'We're reimagining the Food52 Shop. Good things and great finds are coming soon. Thanks for your patience.' (also present in the Sanity page document, _type headingContentBlock). The header 'Shop' tab links to this page; the older /shop path 404s. (2) EVERY collection page still resolves HTTP 200 but its server-rendered listing state reports zero products - props.pageProps.collectionResults.results.meta.total == 0 and items == [] on /collections/shop-all, /collections/all-home, /collections/all-tabletop, /collections/dinnerware, /collections/glassware, /collections/vases-decorative-objects and /collections/candles-candle-holders; zero /products/ hrefs render anywhere on any of them. (3) The site's own Shopify Storefront API (food52.myshopify.com, API 2025-01, public token 4ed4fac721279cb447ac4f1bb192b11c recovered from the production config block in _app-52016ac33524ca61.js) returns products(first:5) -> [] shop-wide, and collection(handle:'dinnerware').products -> [] - i.e. no products are published to the storefront at all, while the 92 collection shells still exist. (4) Every product URL 404s (tested /products/brim-bowl-clear, /products/dhalia-stoneware-dinner-plate-camel, /products/smoke-glasses, /products/pillar-table-lamp). RULE 1 TRAP AVOIDED - A STALE SEARCH INDEX STILL RETURNS NON-ZERO TOTALS: the site's search/PLP vendor is Findify (production apiKey 6e0c321a-36d1-42d5-a47c-40ae648cd272, also in _app.js; endpoint POST https://api-v3.findify.io/v3/smart-collection/collections%2F<handle>?key=... with body {user:{uid,sid},limit,offset,t_client} - path-encoded slot, not a body/query 'slug'). That index has NOT been purged and still reports meta.total = 267 for shop-all, 37 dinnerware, 83 vases-decorative-objects, 6 glassware, 2 clocks-lighting, with full item payloads. These numbers are ORPHANED INDEX RESIDUE, NOT LIVE COUNTS - every item they name 404s on the live site and none is published to the Shopify storefront - so none of them was used as qty. This is exactly the Rule 1 'raw platform total is not a usable qty' case. CORPORATE CONTEXT (corroborates the shutdown): Food52 Inc. filed Chapter 11 in Delaware in late 2025 after mass layoffs and was broken up at auction in early 2026 - Food52 itself to America's Test Kitchen (~$9.9M), the Schoolhouse home brand to Troy-CSL (a division of Hudson Valley Lighting Group) for ~$2.2M, and the Dansk tabletop brand to Form Portfolios (~$0.25M). That explains the orphaned /collections/schoolhouse, /collections/dansk and /collections/dansk-holiday-decor shells in the sitemap. NOTE FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: S.N. 258 'Hudson Valley Lighting' (hvlgroup.com) in this same window is the parent of the entity that bought Schoolhouse - not a duplicate-company case, but a real corporate link worth being aware of. WHAT WOULD HAVE BEEN IN SCOPE IF THE SHOP WERE LIVE (recorded for a future re-run, NOT emitted as rows since no live qty exists): from the 92-entry collections sitemap and the Storefront collection titles, the in-scope leaves would have been Dinnerware, Serveware, Glassware, Coffee Mugs & Tea Cups, Decor and Art (/collections/vases-decorative-objects), Planters, Clocks & Lighting, plus title-level triage of Barware (bar tools out, glasses in), Candles & Candle Holders (scented candles are Home Fragrance and out), Outdoor Dining and Outdoor Furniture & Decor (furniture out) and Bath Towels & Accessories (textiles out). Confirmed out of scope regardless: all cookware/bakeware/knives/cutting boards/kitchen tools/appliances/food storage, Flatware & Serving Utensils (cutlery), pantry/oils/chocolate/cookbooks, all textiles (table linens, kitchen linens, bedding, rugs, textiles), Plants/Wreaths/Garlands (faux), Holiday Decorations, Gardening Tools, Cleaning & Laundry, and the entire editorial side of food52.com (the /food, /life, /home, /holiday-stories verticals and their 20 sub-verticals are recipe/blog content, not a product catalogue). No Rule 0.6 type-tree vs room-tree overlap applies - the shop had a single flat type taxonomy and no room navigation.
